nodes.label: DQN Champion Snapshot
nodes.rationale: Snapshot of the Q-network serialized in dqn_champion.json on each new session record score.

nodes.label: Deep Q-Network Implementation
nodes.rationale: Single-agent reinforcement learning using Q-learning and experience replay with backpropagation, overcoming genetic algorithm generational reset.

nodes.label: DQN Epsilon-Greedy Exploration Policy
nodes.rationale: Balances exploration (random action decaying 1.0 -> 0.01) with exploitation (argmax of Q-values).

nodes.label: DQN Experience Replay Buffer
nodes.rationale: Stores last 10,000 experiences and trains with random batches of 32 to break temporal correlation between steps.

nodes.label: DQN Q-Network
nodes.rationale: 9 -> 32 -> 3 relative architecture predicting expected value of relative movements (straight, turn left, turn right) from 3 relative rays.

nodes.label: DQN Target Network
nodes.rationale: Copy of Q-network updated every 100 steps to stabilize training and prevent oscillations in Q-values.

nodes.label: Unified Snake Shell Proposal
nodes.rationale: Proposes unifying dual binaries into a single app with welcome menu and 5 views while deferring algorithm fixes.

nodes.label: Unified Snake Rust App
nodes.rationale: Compiles a single snake binary unifying GA and DQN across 5 interactive views.

nodes.label: Unified Snake Shell 5-Slice Execution
nodes.rationale: Chained slice delivery implementing unified shell with strict TDD, passing 54 unit tests.
